en: \[VSCode] Fixed raw tags for selected code under a reworded prompt, the mode button flashing Manual, the slash menu hiding its highlighted row, a broken sign-in image, and a blinking Accept/Reject bar
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了改写后的 prompt 下所选代码显示原始标签、模式按钮闪烁显示 Manual、斜杠菜单隐藏高亮行、登录图片损坏以及 Accept/Reject 栏闪烁的问题
